XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine failure to start following a stop whilst moving
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INIEZIONE | P1673 | CENTRALINA | INIEZIONE | AVVIA | PARTE | ACCENDE | MANCATA | ACCENSIONE | MANCATO | AVVIAMENTO | FUNZIONA | FUNZIONAMENTO | AVVIO | SPEGNE | ARRESTA | BLOCCA | MUORE | MOVIMENTO | STRADA | CORSA |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Injection control unit

  • Fault: Engine failure to start following a sudden stop whilst driving

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P1673 (Capacitor 1 voltage – Fault)

  • Cause: Faulty injection control unit

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the fuel injection control unit and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located in the engine compartment, on the driver’s side.
